## Relevant Symbols

- `hooks/status-board.sh:215-238` — `item_body`: the nonce delimiter shape, `<<<untrusted-begin <id> <nonce>` … `untrusted-end <nonce>>>>`, with comments stripped by `strip_comments:214`. The github path must emit the same shape.
- `hooks/status-board.sh:342-363` — `item_rfc`: the RFC path rules, reading the body through `item_body raw`. Reused unchanged when `item_body` dispatches by source.
- `hooks/status-board.sh:577-595` — `add_item`: the title rules (`^[^#$'\r\n']{3,120}$`, no item id).
- `hooks/status-board.sh:453-454` — `ID_PATTERN` default `[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+){1,4}`. `BC-42` matches it, so ledger `valid_id` accepts github ids.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:61` — PUBLISH_MARKERS_DEFAULT; publish computes a state key (`plan|build|pr|done|block|human_block`) before choosing a marker.
- `hooks/status-board.sh:488-506` — `gh_preflight`: the existing scope message for `read:project`.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions

- Fetchers print the answer on stdout at exit 0, or the reason on stderr at non-zero (`status-board.sh:14-16`, constitution 5).
- gh is resolved once through `gh_bin` (`lane-lib.sh:131`). The tests inject a named fake through `HEFESTO_GH_BIN` (`tests/smoke-merge.sh`, `tests/smoke-train.sh`).
- A refusal echoes board text only through `safe_name` (`status-board.sh:316`).
- The board's one write path is `--mark`, called only by `ledger.sh publish` (`status-board.sh:270-274`, `ledger.sh:771-774`).

## Findings That Drive the Plan

- **File size.** `status-board.sh` has 484 code lines and `ledger.sh` 701 (`grep -cvE '^\s*(#|$)'`), so new code goes in a sourced `hooks/board-github.sh`, and publish delegates to a `status-board.sh` mode instead of growing `ledger.sh`.
- **Config key clash.** An external board's config already uses `repos` for name → path (`docs/install.md:566-568`). The issue-repo map takes a new key, `issues`.
- **Author data.** `gh issue view --json` has no `authorAssociation` or `editor`. One GraphQL query reads number, title, body, url, labels, `authorAssociation`, `author`, `editor` and the item's Project entries with their Status.
- **Listing.** `gh project item-list --format json --limit N` returns each item's `content` {type, number, repository, title, url} and `status`. A result count equal to the limit is refused, because the list may be incomplete.
- **Moving a card** needs the Project node id, the Status field id and the option id (`gh project field-list --format json`, `gh project view --format json`), then `gh project item-edit --id --project-id --field-id --single-select-option-id`.
